title: Evidence source ticks and folder completion
details: Yellow ticks now mean learner evidence, purple ticks mean recognised prior learning, and blue ticks mean assessor observation from Milos
Job and category folders only receive a yellow tick when every evidence area underneath is covered
Learner evidence, RPL and Milos observation all contribute to course coverage and folder completion
Mixed evidence sources can complete a folder; the completed folder itself always shows one yellow tick
summary: Evidence colours now show where coverage came from, while folder ticks only appear when everything inside is covered.
changes: Removed partial folder ticks caused by evidence counts
Added purple RPL tick badges and blue Milos observation tick badges
Combined learner, RPL and Milos coverage for KSB/AC progress
Refreshed the installed-app cache to v105
